label: Topic は written as わ
rule: The topic particle is pronounced wa but always written は. Only the word わたし starts with わ.

label: これ vs この
rule: これ stands alone as a noun (this one); この must be followed by a noun (this pen). Same split for それ/その and あれ/あの.

label: 4th-year student is よねんせい
rule: Before ねんせい, four is よ, not よん: よねんせい. The ん is dropped.

label: 4:00 is よじ
rule: Four o'clock is よじ. Neither よんじ nor しじ exists.

label: 7:00 is しちじ
rule: Seven o'clock is しちじ in Genki. ななじ is only heard in announcements for clarity.

label: 9:00 is くじ
rule: Nine o'clock is くじ, never きゅうじ.

label: ぷん vs ふん minutes
rule: Minutes ending in 1, 3, 4, 6, 8, 10 take ぷん (いっぷん, さんぷん, よんぷん, ろっぷん, はっぷん, じゅっぷん); the rest take ふん.

label: 20 years old is はたち
rule: Twenty years old has its own word, はたち. Genki does not accept にじゅっさい.

label: いっさい / はっさい / じゅっさい
rule: Before さい, いち becomes いっ, はち becomes はっ, and じゅう becomes じゅっ.
Hundreds mutate: さんびゃく (b after ん), ろっぴゃく and はっぴゃく (small っ plus p). Every other hundred is plain ひゃく.
Thousands mutate twice: さんぜん (z after ん) and はっせん (small っ). Everything else is plain せん.

label: 10,000 is いちまん
rule: Japanese groups large numbers by ten thousand (まん), and 10,000 itself needs いち: いちまん, never just まん.

label: Dakuten voicing
rule: Two small ticks voice the consonant (か→が, さ→ざ, た→だ, は→ば); the small circle on the は row makes p (ぱ).

label: Small っ and long vowels
rule: Small っ doubles the next consonant (きって = kitte) and a repeated vowel or ー stretches the sound (おおきい = ookii). Dropping either changes the word.

label: シ / ツ lookalikes
rule: Look at the two small ticks! シ stacks ticks vertically on the LEFT and sweeps UP-right (horizontal alignment, like Hiragana し's upward hook). ツ lines ticks side-by-side at the TOP and drops DOWN-left (like Hiragana つ starting across the top).

label: ソ / ン lookalikes
rule: Exact same geometry rule as ツ vs シ! ソ starts at the TOP and drops steeply DOWN-left (matches ツ). ン has a horizontal left tick and sweeps UP-right from the bottom (matches シ).

label: は / ほ lookalikes
rule: Count the horizontal bars on the right! は has ONE bar and its vertical stem pokes out the top. ほ has TWO bars (top bar acts as a flat roof/hat so nothing pokes above it: 'ho-ho-ho' Santa hat).

label: さ / き lookalikes
rule: Count the crossbars! さ has ONE crossbar ('sa'-lsa). き has TWO teeth like a house 'key'. (Note: in print fonts the bottom curve connects; in handwriting there's a small gap—both are the same letter.)

label: ね / れ / わ lookalikes
rule: Left side is identical on all three—only inspect the bottom-right ending! ね curls into a 'ne'-ko (cat) tail loop; れ kicks OUTWARD like a 're'-lay sprinter; わ curves smoothly INWARD like a round 'wa'-sp belly.

label: ぬ / め lookalikes
rule: ぬ ends in an extra 'nu'-dle (noodle) pigtail loop; め stops cleanly in a smooth eye curve with no loop.

label: る / ろ lookalikes
rule: る wraps a 'ru'-by loop at the bottom; ろ is a plain '3' road with zero loop.

label: ウ / ワ / フ lookalikes
rule: Subtract strokes step by step: ウ has a top chimney tick + left wall; ワ drops the top tick (just left wall + curve); フ drops BOTH (just roof + right curve).

label: マ / ム / ア lookalikes
rule: マ folds DOWN from a horizontal top bar into a short center tick; ム builds UP from a flat bottom triangle base; ア drops a long curving leg all the way down.

label: ク / ケ / タ lookalikes
rule: ク is clean inside; タ adds a taco-filling tick inside ク; ケ extends the horizontal bar out to the right.
